text:
maria_dev: CI is red on main — integration suite failing against Hosted API after yesterday's runtime bump. Seen by anyone else?

ci-bot: TEST FAILURE report: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/8842 — 12 failing tests (integration/hosted/*).

ajenkins: hitting the same locally. Errors look auth-y for streaming endpoints: `401` on `POST /v1/stream` during tool-calling tests.

devin: can you paste a snip of the error?

maria_dev: here from CI logs:
```
ERROR: Tool call handshake failed: auth error: token validation failed (exp mismatch)
request: POST /v1/stream?session=abc123 -> 401 Unauthorized
stack: runtime/streaming.go:142 -> runtime/auth.go:58
```

sophie: hmm, we rotated the hosted API service token yesterday for the canary region. CI should be using `HOSTED_API_TOKEN` from vault though — any chance the runner env didn't pick up new secret?

ryan: checking vault audit: CI job read `secret/ci/hosted_token` at 2025-11-06T09:12:03Z and got old value, vault agent on the runner might be caching.

ajenkins: that would explain the auth fail, but what about the streaming/toolcall schema failures? A couple tests show payload mismatch on `tool_metadata` while calling a function.

ci-bot: Failing test list excerpt:
- integration/hosted/test_stream_toolcall.py::TestToolCall::test_function_metadata_mismatch
- integration/hosted/test_auth_rotation.py::TestAuth::test_token_refresh

maria_dev: repro command I used: `TOX_ENV=integration pytest tests/integration/hosted -k toolcall -q` on mac.

devin: @ryan can you force a CI rerun after clearing the vault cache on runners? Also we should bisect to the runtime bump commit — if it's a token format change that broke validation + schema flattening only in streaming path.

ryan: will do a quick rerun now after forcing vault reload on the ephemeral runners. Trigger: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/8842/trigger-rerun

sophie: in parallel, I can run the failing test locally against staging hosted (with current token) and with a rotated token to try to reproduce the schema mismatch.

ajenkins: assigning myself to bisect. Which commit range? The bump was merged yesterday: `main`~1..HEAD includes runtime:streaming v1.12.8. I'll bisect to see if the change introduced a KV cache serialization change that affects the tool metadata shape.

ci-bot: rerun queued by ryan — build #8842.2 started.

maria_dev: thanks. quick note — please don't merge any rollout of streaming v1.12.8 until we confirm. Adding `do-not-ship/streaming` tag to the PRs. :no_entry_sign:

devin: if bisect points to the runtime change, we might need a hotfix to accept both old/new token formats for a short window and add a compatibility adapter for tool metadata keys.

ryan: rerun finished: looks like auth tests are now passing (vault reload worked), but 3 streaming toolcall tests still fail with `schema mismatch: missing "tool_metadata.version"` on payload.

ajenkins: bisect update: landed on commit `c3f9a1f` which adjusted streaming payload flattening for performance (removed nested `meta` wrapper). That explains the missing `tool_metadata.version`. Tests expect nested version key.

sophie: ok that's clear. Plan: 1) update integration tests to accept both shapes temporarily, 2) add compatibility layer in runtime to emit nested `tool_metadata` when `compat_mode` flag on config, and 3) rollout with canary and flag off by default.

maria_dev: agree. @ajenkins can you open a PR for the test tolerance + a follow-up runtime PR with the compatibility flag? I'll prep a release note and coordinate a canary.

ajenkins: yep I'll PR the test change first (small). Then runtime PR for compat shim.

devin: if someone can add a short integration regression in the CI matrix that runs old-shape acceptance, that will help.

ryan: created issue INF-742 and linked the bisect commit, and added `do-not-ship` on streaming deploys. CI now shows green for auth failing tests; overall integration build is unstable until the runtime fix.

maria_dev: thanks team — ping here when the test PR is merged so I can kick a full run. :thumbsup:

ajenkins: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1192 (test tolerance). Running against CI now.

ci-bot: CI for PR #1192: build 8850 queued.

maria_dev: leaving this thread open for updates. If anyone adds manual reruns, drop the run link here.
